scenario_provenance.archetype_label: Inference: a significance test or confidence interval
validity_rules: one-proportion significance-test setting with stated H0 and Ha
p-value interpretation must be conditional on H0 being true
tail event must be as extreme as or more extreme than the observed sample result in the direction of Ha

sources.note: the item stem's verb must match the scored demand

prompt: A significance test is performed using a random sample of households to test H0: p = 0.60 against Ha: p < 0.60, where p is the proportion of all households that used the curbside recycling program last month. The sample result was the sample participation rate was below 0.60, and the p-value is 0.008. Which statement correctly interprets the p-value in context?

options.text: If the proportion of all households that used the curbside recycling program last month really is 0.60, then there is about a 0.8% chance of getting a sample proportion this large or larger by random sampling alone.

misconception_source.label: Reversed the direction of the extreme-tail event

sources.note: p-value meaning depends on the alternative-hypothesis direction and the corresponding tail event

options.text: There is about a 0.8% chance that the sample result happened by chance.

misconception_source.label: Interpreted the p-value as the probability that the sample result happened by chance

sources.note: 2025 CR patterns flag weak p-value interpretations that say only 'due to chance' instead of conditioning on H0 and an extreme-tail event

options.text: There is about a 0.8% chance that the alternative hypothesis is true.

misconception_source.label: Interpreted the p-value as evidence that the alternative hypothesis is true with that probability

sources.note: significance-test interpretation distinguishes evidence against H0 from posterior probability that Ha is true

options.text: If the proportion of all households that used the curbside recycling program last month really is 0.60, then there is about a 0.8% chance of getting a sample result at least as small as the one in the sample (a sample proportion this small or smaller) by random sampling alone.

parts.prompt: A significance test is performed using a random sample of households to test H0: p = 0.60 against Ha: p < 0.60, where p is the proportion of all households that used the curbside recycling program last month. The sample result was the sample participation rate was below 0.60, and the p-value is 0.008. Which statement correctly interprets the p-value in context?

criteria.description: Selects the interpretation of a p-value as a conditional tail probability under H0 in context.
criteria.required_evidence: Correctly conditions on H0 and refers to a result as extreme as or more extreme than the observed result.

provenance.note: Authored conceptual frame; correctness from p-value interpretation taxonomy.
